name: doiget
description: OA-first paper fetcher: DOIs/arXiv IDs to local PDFs + metadata via Open Access APIs.
long_description: doiget is a single-binary, stdio MCP server that turns DOIs and arXiv IDs into local PDFs and structured metadata through official Open-Access APIs (Crossref, Unpaywall, arXiv, OpenAlex). It never bypasses paywalls and makes no network call that is not the direct result of a fetch you ask for. PDFs and metadata are saved to a local store; nothing is redistributed or phoned home. It is the agent-facing companion to BiblioFetch.jl and shares the same on-disk paper store.

store_root.title: Paper store location
store_root.description: Directory where fetched PDFs and metadata are saved. Defaults to a doiget-papers folder under your home directory.

tools.name: doiget_fetch_paper
tools.description: Resolve a DOI or arXiv id and download its Open-Access PDF to the local store.

tools.name: doiget_resolve_paper
tools.description: Resolve a DOI or arXiv id to authoritative metadata (no download).

tools.name: doiget_metadata_only
tools.description: Resolve a ref to metadata only — guarantees no PDF or publisher fetch.

tools.name: doiget_batch_fetch
tools.description: Fetch up to 100 DOIs / arXiv ids in one rate-limited call.

tools.name: doiget_batch_from_bibliography
tools.description: Fetch every resolvable reference from a .bib / CSL-JSON bibliography file.

tools.name: doiget_info
tools.description: Return a stored entry's metadata.

tools.name: doiget_search_local
tools.description: Search the local store by title / authors / venue.

tools.name: doiget_paper_search
tools.description: Discover literature via OpenAlex full-text search (abstract-bearing candidates; never fetches a PDF).

tools.name: doiget_paper_text
tools.description: Extract an arXiv paper's full text from ar5iv as sectioned plain text (never opens the PDF blob).

tools.name: doiget_paper_tex_source
tools.description: Fetch an arXiv paper's LaTeX source as structured text.

tools.name: doiget_link
tools.description: Resolve a DOI to its arXiv preprint + cross-id identity cluster (DOI / arXiv / OpenAlex / title) over OpenAlex.

tools.name: doiget_list_recent
tools.description: List the most recently fetched entries.

tools.name: doiget_paper_pdf_path
tools.description: Return the local path of a cached PDF (does not read, parse, or transmit content).

tools.name: doiget_capability_profile
tools.description: Report which sources this instance is allowed to use.

tools.name: doiget_health
tools.description: Operational health: store writable, version, schema.

tools.name: doiget_expand_citation_graph
tools.description: Breadth-first expansion of a paper's citation graph (hard-capped).

tools.name: doiget_bibtex_export
tools.description: Export one or many stored entries as BibTeX.

tools.name: doiget_csl_export
tools.description: Export one or many stored entries as CSL-JSON.

tools.name: doiget_resolve_citation
tools.description: Resolve a free-form bibliographic citation string to ranked DOI candidates.

tools.name: doiget_batch_resolve_citations
tools.description: Batch-resolve bibliographic citation strings to ranked DOI candidates.

tools.name: doiget_tag
tools.description: Add or remove tags on a stored entry.

tools.name: doiget_annotate
tools.description: Add or clear a note on a stored entry.
